name: Extended Mouse Atlas (E6.5–E9.5 scRNA-seq)
size_note: 430,339 cells; processed h5ad is distributed in a 25 GB archive
license_note: Paper is CC BY 4.0; verify the dataset's accompanying terms before redistribution.

t1.note: All atlas stages are at or before E9.5.

t2-embryo.note: Remove cells strictly between E7.25 and E8.0.

t2-heart.note: Remove cells strictly between E8.25 and E8.75, notably E8.5.

t3.note: The main atlas is wild type; still disclose the source and do not mix in held-out-gene perturbations.

name: sc3D / Slide-seq whole mouse embryo maps
stages: whole E8.5 and E9.0; partial E9.5
license_note: The paper is CC BY 4.0; inspect the Figshare/GEO record for the exact file terms you use.

t1.note: E8.5–E9.5 is not in the extrapolation-protected window.

t2-embryo.note: These stages are after the protected (E7.25, E8.0) interpolation interval.

t2-heart.note: E8.5 is protected; E9.0 and E9.5 are allowed. Process files separately.

t3.note: Use the WT embryo files only; the study also contains mutant experiments that require separate review.

name: GSE247450 embryonic endothelial MERFISH
stages: E9.5 WT (two sagittal regions) and E15.5 WT
license_note: Public GEO record; verify paper/data terms before redistribution.

t1.note: E9.5 is allowed and E15.5 is after E13.5.

t2-embryo.note: Neither stage is inside the embryo interpolation window.

t2-heart.note: E9.5 is allowed and E15.5 is after the protected extrapolation window.

t3.note: The listed MERFISH samples are wild type, not the held-out Gata4/β-catenin KOs.

name: Tabula Muris adult mouse atlas
modality: single-cell RNA-seq across adult mouse tissues
license_note: Public atlas; processed Scanpy files are documented by the project. Check the exact source terms you download.

t1.note: Adult data are later than E13.5.

t2-embryo.note: Adult data are outside the interpolation window.

t2-heart.note: Adult data are later than E13.5.

t3.note: No held-out embryonic knockout measurement is involved.

name: Mouse Gene Ontology annotations (MGI/GO)
modality: curated gene-function annotations, not measured embryo expression
license_note: Follow GO/MGI citation and data-use guidance for the release you download.

t1.note: Functional annotations are not a measurement of a held-out embryo stage.

t2-embryo.note: Functional annotations are not a measurement of a held-out embryo stage.

t2-heart.note: Functional annotations are not a measurement of a held-out embryo stage.

t3.note: Potentially useful for conditioning on perturbation identity; disclose it.
